name: quantro-js
description: Bağımlılıksız tam JavaScript kuantum devre simülatörü — Bell/GHZ dolanıklık, tohumlanabilir PRNG. Tarayıcı + Node (MIT).

scripts.test: node -e "const q=require('./quantro.js');const c=new q.QuantumCircuit(2);q.bellState(c);const d=q.sampleDistribution(c,1024,42);if(d[0]<400||d[3]<400)process.exit(1);console.log('quantro-js: Bell |00> (%d) + |11> (%d) örnekleme OK',d[0],d[3])"
